title: IAM Guardrails Terraform module for Private VPC deployments
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a reusable Terraform module that provides opinionated IAM/RBAC guardrails for Redwood Private (VPC) deployments. This module should enable safe, least-privilege defaults for Customer VPC onboarding, provide easy cross-account role templates for control-plane <> tenant account relationships, and include upgrade/rollout paths and health checks suitable for CI/CD pipelines and automated audits. The goal is to reduce onboarding friction, avoid over-privileged bootstrap roles, and make upgrades (policy changes or role rotations) auditable and reversible.
acceptance_criteria: Module exposes documented role templates: control-plane-admin, runtime-admin, monitoring-reader, kms-encryptor with minimal scoped policies
Module supports cross-account role creation with configurable trust principals and session duration
Upgrade strategy implemented: change-set preview plan + automated migration helper that can detect breaking permission reductions and produce a rollback plan
Automated health checks: IAM policy diffs and role assumeability tests run in CI; failing checks block Terraform apply
Examples and integration tests exist: example-private-deploy/ with step-by-step bootstrap and automated acceptance tests
Security review completed and gating policy added to internal registry (policy-doc link in ticket)
tasks: Design module interface and variable set (inputs/outputs) - wireframe in Confluence
Implement base TF module with role templates and least-priv policy JSONs
Add cross-account trust helper and example usage for Dedicated/private clusters
Create upgrade helper scripts (plan analyzer + rollback manifest generator)
Write automated assume-role and policy-diff health checks for CI
Add unit/integration tests and example repo directory
Submit for security review and iterate on feedback
Document migration path and runbook for existing customers

notes: Avoid creating single 'owner' role with broad wildcard permissions - prefer smallest-permission roles and composition at usage time.
Consider adding an optional SSM parameter or Secrets Manager output for role rotation metadata to help with audits.
We will prioritize making the module non-destructive by default: apply cannot delete roles it did not create without explicit flag.
Plan to pair with Redwood Console team to ensure role ARNs and external_id conventions match onboarding UX
